ch0250_80_saida/0101_0701_200_10:
Let’s study as best we can today. I’m looking
forward to it.
ch0250_80_saida/7101_0701_100_10:
Sometimes between training or studying,
I go for a walk with my Pokémon.
ch0250_80_saida/7101_0701_200_10:
Fresh air or a change of scenery can be
invigorating—and relaxing.
ch0250_80_saida/7102_0701_100_10:
Although I like moving my body, I don’t
dislike studying.
ch0250_80_saida/7102_0701_200_10:
I strive for excellence—both academic and
physical. To be strong, power alone isn’t
enough.
ch0250_80_saida/7103_0701_100_10:
I make sure to carry something to snack on
between classes.
ch0250_80_saida/7103_0701_200_10:
The right amount of sugar helps me focus
and gives me an extra push.
ch0250_80_saida/7103_0701_300_10: Of course, I’m careful not to go overboard.
ch0250_80_saida/7104_0701_100_10:
I feel like I learn better if I exercise before
studying.
ch0250_80_saida/7104_0701_200_10:
A healthy body improves the mind...
It’s all connected.
ch0250_80_saida/7105_0701_300_10:
I was on a study break, but I got too
comfortable and became sleepy...
ch0250_80_saida/7105_0701_400_10:
How embarrassing... Please, forget what
you saw.
ch0250_80_saida/1701_0701_200_10:
Please, take this. I found it on my way back
from school.
ch0250_80_saida/1701_0702_200_10: I hope you find a use for it.
ch0250_80_saida/2501_0701_100_10:
Hm? It’s nice seeing me in something other
than my Gym uniform?
ch0250_80_saida/2501_0701_200_10:
Hehe! When you spend a lot of time with
someone, you see more sides to them!
ch0250_80_saida/2501_0702_100_10:
When I dress casually, somehow it calms my
competitive spirit.
ch0250_80_saida/2501_0702_200_10:
I’ve learned it’s important to adapt your
outfit to the situation.
ch0250_80_saida/2511_0701_100_10:
Sometimes after school, I stop at new shops
I’ve found to try their desserts.
ch0250_80_saida/2511_0701_200_10: It’s a secret pleasure of mine.
ch0250_80_saida/2511_0701_300_10:
One nice thing about this outfit is I’m less
recognizable to my fans.
ch0250_80_saida/2511_0702_100_10:
Nessa told me about a wonderful dessert
shop the other day.
ch0250_80_saida/2511_0702_200_10: Would you like to come with me?
ch0250_80_saida/2511_0702_300_10: It has a few things I’d love for you to try.
ch0250_80_saida/3001_0701_100_10:
The air is refreshing, isn’t it? Let’s start the
day with some stretches to balance our
bodies and minds.
ch0250_80_saida/3003_0701_100_10:
Thinking sure works up an appetite, doesn’t
it? Fancy going for dessert somewhere?
ch0250_80_saida/3005_0701_100_10:
What did you learn today? Self-reflection
should be part of any training regimen.
